query.prima: select o.id from orders_visible o where o.company_id = 1 and o.deleted_at is null and o.visible and (o.description ilike '%Rossi%' or o.order_code ilike '%Rossi%' or o.client_name ilike '%Rossi%') order by o.id limit 20
query.dopo:
select o.id from orders_visible o left join profiles p on p.id = o.customer_id and (p.first_name ilike '%Rossi%' or p.last_name ilike '%Rossi%')
  where o.company_id = 1 and o.deleted_at is null and o.visible and (o.description ilike '%Rossi%' or o.order_code ilike '%Rossi%' or o.client_name ilike '%Rossi%' or p.id is not null) order by o.id limit 20
